name: Cleaning Cost Calculator Oletheme
author: oletheme

sections.description:
Cleaning Cost Calculator Oletheme allows you to easily add a professional cleaning cost estimator to your WordPress website.
This plugin is designed for cleaning service companies and freelancers who want to provide transparent pricing and improve customer trust.

Main features:
– 3 types of cleaning: regular, after-renovation, and commercial
– Flexible configuration of costs, time and additional options
– Global settings: currency, labels, and time format
– User-friendly shortcode for adding the calculator to any page or post
– Clean and responsive interface with real-time calculation of price and time

Usage

  • Open the Calculator of cleaning section in your admin panel.
  • In Global Settings you can configure:
  • Calculator title
  • Currency (e.g., $, €, ₴, zł)

  • Time format and labels

  • Configure types of cleaning:

  • Regular cleaning
  • After-renovation cleaning
  • Commercial cleaning

For each type you can set:
– Cost per service or per area
– Estimated time
– Additional options and extra services

Frontend view:
– Users will see a simple form where they can select the type of cleaning and services.
– At the top of the calculator, the total cost and estimated time are automatically displayed.
– The calculator is responsive and works well on both desktop and mobile.

Feedback & Support

We’d love to hear your feedback!
If you have questions, problems, or feature requests, please open a topic in the Support Forum.

If you find this plugin useful, please consider leaving a ★★★★★ rating on WordPress.org – your feedback helps us release updates faster.

If you’d like to support development, you can buy me a coffee here.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for Cleaning Cost Calculator Oletheme.
    Click Install Now and then Activate.

  2. Alternatively, download the plugin as a ZIP archive and upload it manually:

    • Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
    • Select the ZIP file and click Install Now
    • After installation, click Activate Plugin

  3. After activation, you will see a new menu item in the admin panel: Calculator of cleaning.

  4. Configure your calculator in the Global Settings (currency, labels, time settings).

  5. Insert the calculator into any page or post using the shortcode: [ccalc_cleaning_calculator]
sections.faq:
Can I change the cost of cleaning?

Yes, you can fully customize the cost of each service in the plugin settings.

Can I change the time required for each service?

Yes, all time settings are flexible and editable.

Can I change the currency?

Yes, you can set any currency symbol in the global settings.

Can I use different languages?

Currently the plugin uses English by default, but you can edit labels directly in the settings.

Can I add multiple calculators to different pages?

Yes, simply use the shortcode [ccalc_cleaning_calculator] on any page or post.

Does it work with Gutenberg and classic editor?

Yes, you can add the shortcode to both Gutenberg blocks and the Classic Editor.

Will it work with Elementor?

Yes, the shortcode works perfectly inside Elementor widgets.

Can I disable unnecessary cleaning types?

Yes, you can enable or disable any cleaning type in the settings.
